blogTitle: typed offline in notepad, pasted when the line is free
about: hi im doug. i have dial-up. it says 56k on the box but its 26.4 on a good night because we live 4 miles past where the cable stops. every glitter gif on this site costs me about a minute. every profile song costs me 9. so when i tell you i looked at your page, understand that i LOOKED at your page. i read your whole about me while the pictures came in one stripe at a time. the internet line is also the house phone, and my mom calls my aunt carol every night at 7:30, so if i stop in the middle of a sentence it isnt rude, its just 7:30. i type everything in notepad first so its ready to paste. the cable company says we get broadband next spring. they have said next spring for 3 springs.
aboutMore: things i can do while a page loads: make a sandwich. feed the barn cats. do my algebra. watch one stripe of brittanys default picture arrive (its her forehead. it has been her forehead since tuesday). on saturdays i bike 6 miles to the library, which has a fast line and a one hour limit, and i bring a list. half the list is things other people asked me to look up. i can also do the entire modem connecting sound with my mouth. 22 seconds. third place at the 4-H talent show.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: whoever at the cable company keeps saying next spring. the person who invented the progress bar, to ask if they know it lies. a glitter gif under 20k. and everybody on here, in person, because i have honestly never seen most of your pictures finish loa

interests.General: waiting, notepad, knowing file sizes by heart, turning images off, the library on saturdays (computer 3, by the window), biking, barn cats, 4-H, reading the whole page, call waiting (enemy), aunt carol (not an enemy. but)
interests.Music: the first 40 seconds of a lot of songs. madonna - hung up (i have heard up to the first chorus. it seems good), the modem sound (i can sing it), whatever larry burns me (its never what the cd says), the radio in the barn (country and one polka hour)
interests.Movies: anything that comes on a tape or a disc. napoleon dynamite, october sky, the sandlot, holes. i have never watched a video on the internet all the way through. i saw 11 seconds of a cat once. it was really good
interests.Television: we get 4 channels and one is in french. jeopardy, the red green show, packers games, whatever is on while mom is on the phone
interests.Books: hatchet (hes patient. i get it), where the red fern grows, the troubleshooting booklet that came with the modem, your about me sections (all of them. cover to cover)
interests.Heroes: my mom (shes on her feet all day at the diner, the phone is her one thing, i can wait), the saturday librarian, larry (mails me the internet on cds), lars (showed me the text browser), anybody who makes a website under 100k

bulletins.subject: PLEASE put file sizes in your bulletins (a request from the countryside)
bulletins.body: hi. doug here. typed offline. small request. when you post a picture or a glitter thing or a song, could you put how big it is in the subject. like 'new pics (2 megs)' or 'my layout (sit down, doug)'. i am on dial-up and every click is a bet. yesterday i clicked a bulletin called 'lol' and it was a 4 meg picture of a taco. that was 13 minutes. it was a good taco. but i would have liked to choose. things under 100k i will look at right away. things under 1 meg, tonight. things over 1 meg, saturday at the library, i will put you on the list. thank you. i read all of your bulletins by the way. every one. the words come first.

blog.title: what saturday at the library is like
blog.body: typed sunday, pasting whenever. every saturday i bike to the library in town. its 6 miles. theres a hill by the co-op that i walk. the library has 4 computers and a fast line and a clipboard, and you get one hour. i get there when it opens. computer 3, by the window. i bring a list on notebook paper. this week: 1) see megs horse of me at full size. 2) watch nicks cartoon without it stopping to think. 3) look at everyones default pictures so i know who you all are (brittany is not just a forehead. good for her). 4) print lizs lite layout. then theres the part of the list thats for other people. my mom wanted a casserole recipe. my dad wanted a part number for the baler. mr olson down the road wanted to know if his cousin in arizona has a web page (he does. its about cactus). i print it all, 10 cents a page. then i bike home with the internet in my backpack. its my favorite day.

blog.title: things i know about you because the words load first
blog.body: on fast internet i think a profile shows up all at once and your eyes go to the picture. mine comes in order. name. headline. then the about me, the whole thing, sitting there in plain letters for a minute or two before anything shiny arrives. so i read it. heres what i know. patrick has a rock and the rock has a name. todd runs this place off a laptop and worries about it. raven puts periods on everything and is nicer than she lets on. chad typed his own about me and is proud of that, you can tell. dave has never hacked anything and i hope he never does because i think it would scare him. nobody reads the books section but me. half of you have the same book in there and havent noticed. by the time the glitter loads i already like you. i think if everybody had to wait 9 minutes for each other it would be a nicer website. anyway its 7:29 so
